descriptionChirho: The proper name Yekhonyah/Yekhanyah (יְכוֹנְיָה), meaning 'YHWH establishes,' referring to Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) king of Judah, carried into Babylonian exile. The three clusters represent orthographic and morphological variants of the same royal name: Yekhanyah (S101970, 4x), Yekhonyah/Yekhanyahu with -hu theophoric suffix (S101969, 2x), and Yechonyah (S101972, 1x). All translations treat these as one person: Spanish Yejanya/Jeconías, Arabic يَكَنيا/يَكُونْيَا (Yakaniyā/Yakūniyā), Hindi यकोन्याह/यकन्याहू (Yakonyāh), Korean 여고냐/여고니야 (Yeogonyā), Swahili Yekonia.
